Adani Group Denies Plans to Enter Airline Business

Reports suggested the Adani Group was considering entering the airline business and seeking regulatory changes. However, the Adani Group has officially denied these reports, stating they are not evaluating any proposal to enter the airline sector. This clarification comes amidst discussions about potential relaxations in airport-airline ownership rules.
